verdict.rationale: An online tax-services portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on a user's account data, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents conventional e-services: registration, filing, payments, calculators, document submission and EFILE. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The llms.txt probe concerns agent-oriented docs, not in-product AI insights, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
